subject: Coverage consolidation: accelerated field seat request (Q3 coverage surge)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-05-16 09:12 -0700
Subject: Coverage consolidation: accelerated field seat request (Q3 coverage surge)

Team —

We have a short-term coverage gap building across our retail & POS vertical accounts for Q3 (expected 6–8 major demos / PoCs). The simplest path to avoid revenue churn is to accelerate two field SE seats into Q3 rather than Q4. Summary: 

- Ask: approve 2 FTE field SE hires to start recruiting this month (target start: early Aug).
- Rationale: concentrated bookings in Retail + Channel pilots; current SE pool already overloaded (avg ticket handling latency +18% month-over-month).
- Budget impact: net +2 FTE; we propose pulling one open SDR seat and one deferred AE seat from the backlog to limit net new spend. Detailed numbers in attached HC_request_Q3_v1.xlsx and compensation ranges in band_matrix_q3.pdf.

Proposed roles: 1 x Senior Field SE (L4) for strategic retail partners, 1 x Field SE (L3) to handle demos and integrations. Comp bands (high level): L3 base $125–145k, L4 base $145–165k; total target comp ranges shown in the attachment.

Timeline and next steps I need: 
- Marissa: quick decision on headcount movement and final sign-off for comp exceptions (if needed).
- Ben (Sales Ops): confirm we can reallocate the two seats from SDR/AE backlog and share run-rate delta + ramp model.
- Monica (CS): confirm onboarding bandwidth and initial coverage plan for handoff.

If we approve today, recruiting can push two warm candidates (TalentMatch is lined up) and we can extend offers mid-June to hit an Aug start. Please reply with approvals or constraints — short, actionable replies preferred.

Thanks,
Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Director, Field GTM
Redwood Inference

Attachments: HC_request_Q3_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), band_matrix_q3.pdf (pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-16 11:04 -0700
Subject: Re: Coverage consolidation: accelerated field seat request (Q3 coverage surge)

Vanessa — thanks for the clear ask and attachments. High level: I approve moving forward with recruiting for the two seats contingent on Finance signoff on the reallocation plan.

A couple asks before final sign-off: 
- Ben: can you send a one-page run-rate delta (yr1 cost and OTE) and confirm there are no legacy comp obligations on the SDR seat you propose to repurpose?
- Vanessa: confirm target interview loop and expected 8-week ramp milestones (I want L3 to hit partial coverage within 60 days).

Assuming those are green, I will ok the comp exceptions for one senior hire (L4) up to the top of the band if the profile justifies it. Please get me the one-pager and a short recruiter briefing by EOD tomorrow.

—Marissa
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: TalentMatch <emma@talentmatch.co>
Date: 2027-05-17 08:46 -0700
Subject: Re: Coverage consolidation: accelerated field seat request (Q3 coverage surge)

Marissa / Vanessa —

I've reviewed the HC_request_Q3_v1 and ran the numbers. Short answers: yes, we can reallocate the two seats with minimal impact to quota coverage if we also reassign 3 named mid-market accounts to nearby AEs for Q3. The kicker is a one-time collar cost for the senior profile if we hire into the top-of-band. Details attached (ramp_model_2yr.xlsx).

Numbers (yr1):
- L3 Field SE: fully loaded cost ~ $175k
- L4 Senior Field SE (top of band): fully loaded cost ~ $225k (includes one-time sign-on of up to $15k)
- Net delta to FY27 run-rate if we convert the SDR seat and move deferred AE: +$58k run-rate (one-time sign-on up to $15k possible).

Operational notes: 
- The SDR seat proposed for reallocation is currently unfilled and has no legacy guarantee.
- Recommend opening two Greenhouse reqs immediately (tags: Q3-ACCEL, Retail-POS). Recruiting is standing by (cc'ed Emma from TalentMatch for contingency).
- Ben will also need compensation sign-off from HR for the L4 exception; Marissa, if you confirm approval, I'll route through PeopleOps and Finance.

I attached a ramp model for 24 months and an initial requisition template. If you want, I can mock an offer package for the two levels this afternoon.

Thanks —
Ben
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-05-19 10:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Coverage consolidation: accelerated field seat request (Q3 coverage surge)

All — quick note from the field: I support an accelerated hire cadence for the two SEs. Approve the reallocation and the comp exception for the L4 at the top of the band (as long as total comp stays within the attached band matrix).

Guidance for offers: 
- L4 Senior Field SE: target base $155k, OTE $210–225k, sign-on up to $15k (if needed).
- L3 Field SE: target base $135k, OTE $165–180k, standard package.

Vanessa: move recruiting forward — Ben, please route the comp exception to PeopleOps and Finance; if PeopleOps OKs today, I want soft offers go out to our warm candidates by Monday (TalentMatch is primed). Monica, plan for a focused onboarding week 0–2 (integration + demo library).

I'll flag this with revenue leadership if offers go above band or we see additional budget needs. Good work on the ask — I want to avoid losing these deals.

Rafael
Head of Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
